authentication.scope: tenant of the terminal; any ACTIVE terminal of the tenant may register, report and retire

download.clock_source: server-assigned per-tenant revision sequence, never wall clock
download.cursor: opaque; omit or empty for a full download from the beginning
download.deletion: none; retired pairs are delivered with state retired
download.next_cursor: always returned; unchanged when the page is empty
download.order: revision ascending; each pair appears once, at its latest revision

merge.equal_time: not applied; the stored reading stands
merge.holder: reporting terminal while state is in_use, otherwise null

registration.identity_compare: kind + value, exact; provenance is not compared
precedence: identity owned by another number (left, then right)
registration.replay_returns: same insole_id at its current revision

manifest.digest: sha256 of the canonical JSON the server re-serializes from the parsed body: sorted keys, no whitespace. Send ended_at in UTC as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.ffffff]Z (microseconds only when non-zero); the server digests its own re-serialization, so any other form gets a digest mismatch unless it re-serializes identically
manifest.idempotency_key: also send Idempotency-Key: chosen by the client, unique per session and stable across retries of its completion

insole_session_archive.metadata_header: unpadded base64url of canonical JSON: sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8

rules.local_quality_outcome: required; only VALID completes to INGESTED, other values get E-CLD-422 REPEAT_SCREENING
rules.schema_pairing: a manifest whose schema_version is not paired with the session payload_schema gets E-CLD-422 UPDATE_CLIENT
rules.segment_schema: segment payload_schema_version must equal the session payload_schema, else E-CLD-422
rules.segment_set: manifest segments must equal the received parts by index, sha256 and size_bytes, else E-CLD-422 UPLOAD_MISSING_SEGMENTS

license_inactive.create: POST /v1/subjects is unchanged (RAY-728 D6): an ACTIVE terminal may still create
license_inactive.reads: GET /v1/subjects, POST /v1/subjects/search-by-name and GET /v1/subject-tags keep working

authentication.scope: tenant of the terminal; any ACTIVE terminal of the tenant

download.clock_source: server-assigned per-tenant revision sequence, never wall clock
download.cursor: opaque; omit or empty for a full download from the beginning
download.deletion: none; archived subjects are delivered with status ARCHIVED
download.next_cursor: always returned; unchanged when the page is empty
download.order: revision ascending; each subject appears once, at its latest revision
revision_bumps: identity, analysis profile or number changed

name_search.audit: every lookup is audited with the result count, never the name
name_search.normalization: NFKC, then trim, then Unicode case fold; exact match only; a name that is empty after normalization matches nothing
name_search.pre_0017_subjects: not findable until their identity is next written (D6)

patch.concurrency: base_revision must equal the current revision; otherwise E-SUB-409-REVISION-CONFLICT with details.current; the server never merges (D4)

merge.external_identifier: replaces the active number, which becomes SUPERSEDED

patch.replay: same Idempotency-Key and body returns 200 with the current record

record_rules.consents: every consent of the subject, granted_at ascending, revoked ones included
record_rules.external_identifier: the active number, masked only (D3); look a number up with POST /v1/subjects/resolve
record_rules.identity_profile: display_name only (D1); contact is never sent (D2); absent when none is stored, for MERGED and RESTRICTED subjects, and when it cannot be decrypted

name_conflict.returns: the existing tag; use its tag_id

terminal_data_plane.capture_authorization: not supported for terminals: X-Capture-Authorization or X-Expected-Manifest-SHA256 is rejected
terminal_data_plane.credential: terminal access token (POST /v1/access/terminal-activate or /v1/access/terminal-refresh); hardware tenant tokens keep working

license.new_session: current License ACTIVE, within validity and enabling screening.start; read on every request, not from the token
license.upload: segments, complete, subject and consent writes need only an ACTIVE terminal

reactivation.same_account_same_installation: keeps client_installation_id; new refresh family; previous refresh sessions SUPERSEDED
reactivation.seat: consumes a seat again; E-TRM-409-SEAT-LIMIT when full
reactivation.sessions_created_before_revoke: segments and complete continue after re-activation

effects: every refresh session of the terminal invalidated
access token gets E-TRM-401-REVOKED on /v1/access/* and the data routes until it expires
self_revoke.logout: POST /v1/access/logout is for hardware login only and does not accept a terminal refresh token
self_revoke.repeat: returns the revoked terminal unchanged; safe to retry
self_revoke.target: the calling terminal itself is supported

session_binding.device_id: insole_id of a non-retired pair in the institution inventory; any terminal of the institution may use it
session_binding.existing_session: segments, complete and status only for sessions the calling terminal created

terminal_data_plane.terminal_status: checked on every request; a revoked terminal gets E-TRM-401-REVOKED even with an unexpired token
terminal_data_plane.x_terminal_id: optional; when sent it must equal client_installation_id

constants.max_bytes_applies_to: uncompressed body; Content-Encoding is not accepted

terminal_diagnostics.credential: terminal access token (POST /v1/access/terminal-activate); any ACTIVE terminal uploads its own export

package.header_ids: tenant_id and terminal_id equal the token tenant and client_installation_id
package.identity_screen: every string, key or value, at any depth: no mobile, landline, e-mail or resident ID number; a key the client Redactor treats as identity holds only redacted_value
package.line_separator: ; the last line ends with it
package.rejection: whole package; details carry only line (1-based) and reason

request_headers.X-Content-SHA256: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact body bytes

response.replay: same key and same SHA-256 returns 200 with the identical body
